Name: Eggstravaganza
Author: dollynhoevida
Description:
The junimos decided to make their own egg hunt!

This mod adds 11 easter eggs, they spawn every year on Spring 12th and 14th.

Eating an egg has a small chance to drop random new and classic items:
[spoiler]
Chocolate Bunny
Chocolate Carrot
Chocolate Shovel
Bunny Boots
Carrot Seeds
Tulip Bulbs
Jazz Seeds
Sunglasses
Mineral Bars D:
Coins
[/spoiler]

You can hunt for eggs in various locations:
[spoiler]
Bus Stop
Backwoods
Town
Mountain
Beach
Forest
Secret Woods
Witch Swamp
[/spoiler]

A junimo will meep when new eggs are spawned on the map 🍏

I wll add quests for the egg basket in the next update.
